plan: Given my value is $10, I should bid conservatively to ensure a profit if I win. Other bidders, aiming to maximize their profit, will likely bid near their own values. To win, I must bid higher than at least one other bidder but not so high that I risk overpaying. I will bid slightly below my value to maximize potential profit while minimizing risk, considering the rational behavior of others.

Given my private value of $6, I should bid conservatively to maximize profit. Rational opponents likely bid close to their values. To win, I should bid slightly above half my value, around $3, as this minimizes potential loss if I win, paying the third-highest bid. If I lose, I incur no cost. This strategy balances winning potential with risk management.

Given my low private value of $4, I should aim to bid conservatively to avoid potential losses. Rational bidders with higher values are likely to bid closer to their values. Since my value is low, bidding high risks paying more than the prize's worth. I will bid below my value to minimize loss, as winning with a bid higher than $4 would result in a net loss. I will bid $2 to ensure I do not pay more than my value.
